attributes.body_ja:
「に応（おう）じて」は「に」と一段（いっぱん）動詞（どうし）「応（おう）じる」のテ形（けい）の組（く）み合（あ）わせです。この文型（ぶんけい）は「(A) に合（あ）わせて (B) をする」や「(A) によって (B) をする」というような意味（いみ）で使（つか）われます。この表現（ひょうげん）は、ただ (A) の影響（えいきょう）を受（う）けて (B) が変（か）わるというよりも、(A) に適（てき）した形（かたち）で (B) が変（か）わるという意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。

「に応（おう）じて」は名詞（めいし）の後（あと）に置（お）かれます。「に応（おう）じた」という形（かたち）で次（つぎ）の名詞（めいし）を修飾（しゅうしょく）することもあります。

豆知識（まめちしき）

「応（おう）じる」は、個々（ここ）の問題（もんだい）や状況（じょうきょう）に合（あ）わせて適切（てきせつ）に「対応（たいおう）する」ことを表（あらわ）します。そのため、(B) の内容（ないよう）は (A) の程度（ていど）や重要（じゅうよう）度（ど）によって変（か）わることが多（おお）いです。
attributes.body:
に応（おう）じて is a combination of に, and the て-form of the る-Verb 応（おう）じる 'to apply to'. This grammar structure is often translated as 'depending on (A), (B)', or 'in response to (A), (B)'. However; in almost all cases, it is just indicating that (B) is something that is done in a way that is 'applicable' to what is necessary of (A).

に応（おう）じて will appear after nouns, or as に応（おう）じた when directly modifying a second noun.

Fun-fact

応（おう）じる usually indicates the way something 'responds to' or 'answers' an issue on a case-by-case basis. Due to this, what happens in (B) will frequently indicate something that changes depending on the intensity or severity of (A).

に沿って and に応じて can both suggest doing something in line with a standard, but differ in nuance. に沿って means according to, as in 会社の方針に沿って行動する (act according to company policy). に応じて implies acting in response to or suitable for something, as in 客のニーズに応じてサービスを提供する (provide a service suitable for customers’ needs).

attributes.body: に応じて and にしたがって can seem similar, but differ in nuance. に応じて means in response to something, as in アンケートの結果に応じて方針を決める (decide policy in response to the survey results). にしたがって refers to directly following guidelines or standards, as in 規則に従って (in accordance with the regulations).

attributes.body: Both can be translated as according to, but differ in nuance. に応じて emphasizes adapting or responding flexibly, as in 年齢に応じて料金が変わる (The fee changes according to age). 次第だ・次第で stresses that the outcome is directly determined by another factor, as in 成功するかどうかは準備次第である (Success depends on preparation).

attributes.body: をもとに indicates a fixed source or basis for something, as in 実話をもとに小説を書く (Write a novel based on true events). に応じて shows flexible adjustment or response to conditions, as in 状況に応じて対応を決める (Decide the response according to the situation).

attributes.body: に応えて means in response to expectations, requests, or demands, as in 要望に応えて商品を改良した (We improved the product in response to requests). に応じて means in line with or according to conditions, adapting as needed, as in 年齢に応じて料金が変わる (The fee changes according to age).

attributes.body: に応じて shows flexible adjustment in proportion to conditions, as in 状況に応じて対応する (Respond according to the situation). からして emphasizes the basis for judgment, meaning judging from or even just from, often with emphasis, as in 態度からして気に入っていない (Judging from his attitude, he doesn’t like it).

attributes.body: Both relate to the idea of one thing being dependent on another, but with different nuance and formality level. に応じて is a formal expression and conveys variation or response depending on conditions, e.g. 必要に応じてサポートする ('Support as needed'), while に合わせて・に合った is less formal and implies actively adjusting to match or suit something, e.g. 季節に合わせて洋服を選ぶ ('Choose clothes to match the season').
